C9000269.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 269 (Uniform Laughlin gap and stability under bounded scalar disorder.; papers: Uniform Stability of the Spherical Laughlin Gap; A Fock-space inequality and the Laughlin spectral gap; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/269.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_RETAINED.statement: For each fixed 0<c<1/25, eventually in integer q, H_q^2 >= c H_q + L_4(W_4 R_q^hi W_4*) on the entire physical Fock space; R_q^hi contains all pair-spin deficits l>=23.
C_RETAINED.classification: Established in the Engineer's proof by a stronger selective-retention theorem; independent Reviewer pending.

C_NORMAL.statement: With norm-one increasing wedges and ordered pair factors, H^2=H+L_3(W_3(W_3*W_3-I)W_3*)+L_4(W_4W_4*).

C_GRAM3.statement: The three-body Gram eigenvalue minus one is (-1)^z (q)_z/(2q-2)_z (3z-1-z(z+1)/q), and z=0,1,3 are annihilated by W_3.

C_COUPLING.statement: Normalized fixed-deficit SU(2) coupling coefficients converge with the stated phases to the orthogonal oscillator-polynomial coefficients, including normalized descendants.

C_FINITE.statement: The supplied seven rows satisfy every strict three-body margin and every compressed four-body PSD inequality G_D(2chi-E_D+3*10^-6 I)G_D>=0 for 1<=D<=23.

C_SUPPORT.statement: The rotationally averaged auxiliary four-body term has support only in total-spin deficits D<=23; no target pair-spin deficit l>=23 is consumed.

C_TRANSFER.statement: Exact diagonal conjugation of the finitely many local pair-generated annihilators transfers compressed limiting positivity with an o(1)H_q error uniformly on full Fock space, including spectators.

C_ALLOWANCE.statement: Bessel before wedging and Haar averaging bound the 3*10^-6 allowance by 1222*(3*10^-6) H_q, uniformly in particle number.

C_TAIL.statement: The negative three-body tail is >=-delta_q H_q, uniformly on full Fock space, with delta_q tending to 61/4096.

C_FOCK_GAP.statement: Companion manuscript thm:fock asserts the eventual full-Fock inequality H_q^2>=gamma H_q for every fixed 0<gamma<4616733319001/10^14.
C_FOCK_GAP.classification: Prior claimed bound; not independently established merely by being staged.

C_STABILITY.statement: Stability thm:main asserts a uniform unique-ground-state gap for all bounded real scalar potentials of norm <=1 at sufficiently small coupling and sufficiently large Laughlin filling.
C_STABILITY.classification: Outside the selected certification frontier; its inputs are not presumed verified.

C_LOCALITY.statement: Stability Section 3 supplies uniform fermionic frames, dynamics, filters, and common-frame locality estimates.

C_PINNING_FLAGS.statement: Stability Sections 4-5 establish zero-space pinning transport, orthogonal histories, and local flag readout including one-hole control.

C_CHARGE.statement: Stability thm:charge-local-linear provides local-observable charge control linear in the number of holes.

C_ENERGY.statement: Stability thm:local-energy-descent constructs uniformly local particle-loss operators resolving H_q and descending energy; grand-canonical coercivity follows.

C_RELATIVE.statement: Stability prop:relative-bound controls neutral local operators annihilating the Laughlin vector by the grand-canonical positive energy, enabling spectral continuation.

C_SELECTIVE.statement: For each fixed 0<c<4785933319001/10^14, eventually on full Fock space, H_q^2>=cH_q+L_4(W_4 R_sel W_4*), where R_sel=I-P_{q,4}-P_{q,10}-P_{q,12}-P_{q,14}. In particular all pair-spin deficits l>=15 are retained with coefficient one.
C_SELECTIVE.classification: Proposed structural strengthening; the gap number alone is weaker than later published bounds and is not claimed novel.
C_SELECTIVE.engineer_status: Complete proof pending independent replay and novelty assessment.

C_SELECTIVE_FINITE.statement: For 1<=D<=23, the compressed matrices G_D(2t_D chi-E_D+eps_D I)G_D are PSD, with t_D=1 exactly at D=5,11,13,15 and eps_D=3/10^6 exactly at D=11,13,14,15,16,17,18,19,20. The Bessel price is 658*(3/10^6).

Thus the present coefficient 0.04785933319001 is not a new gap-only bound. The proposed new assertion concerns selective target retention.
